notes.title: Demo Update Feb 05 (0.3.75)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

There's not much time left before Next Fest starts! So we have prepared one last update before it will begin.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable reticle position smoothing for gamepads
[*] A warning will be shown 2 minutes before the sentries arrive
[*] Added an option to change the "movement mode" for each input method.
[i]The default is "Absolute" which means that the ship will move up/down/left/right relative to your display. The alternative option is "Relative" (also known as "Tank Controls"), which means that the ship will move up/down/left/right relative to the ship.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Agreeing to the privacy policy is no longer required when starting the game for the first time
[*] The feedback button has been replaced with a button that opens the Steam forum of Dusky Depths
[*] The input settings menu has been modified so that it's more clear that it configures each input device separately
[*] Simplified the laser beam puzzle on the second sector
[*] Improved responsiveness of the aiming reticle if a gamepad is used while reticle position smoothing is enabled
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed audio stuttering, especially in sector 2
[*] Fixed a rare crash that may randomly occur while on an expedition
[*] Fixed gamepad settings not being saved
[*] Fixed a crash that may occur when using the SC-IonLauncher
[*] Fixed the Map/Setup action being mislabled in several places
[*] Fixed the Map/Setup action not showing the Map screen first when appropriate
[*] Fixed a specific switch object sometimes not spawning in sector 1
[*] Fixed the Macro Destabilizer item not working
[*] Fixed the minute display of objectives being off by 1 minute sometimes

[/list]

You can also check out our list of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2621270/discussions/0/4036977429243711876/]known issues[/url].

notes.title: Demo Update Feb 02 (0.3.44)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Based on your feedback and bug reports, we have prepared a new patch for the demo.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added/extended various options to customize the HUD[i] (via User Interface Settings)[/i]
[*] Added minimum and maximum reticle clamp options to the gamepad settings menu 
[i](Input Settings -> Change Settings for Gamepad) [/i]
[i]If the minimum is equal or larger than the maximum, then the reticle will no longer dynamically react to collisions.[/i]
[*] Added a reticle clamp shape option ("Oval" or "Circle") to the gamepad settings menu
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When finishing a run, the end match summary will now be shown after a short delay
[*] Assorted minor gameplay balance changes
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed track bar UI elements not moving when holding the left or right direction button down
[*] Fixed navigation towards track bar UI elements sometimes not working when using a gamepad
[*] Fixed drop-down list panels hiding the mouse cursor when hovering above them while ingame
[/list]

You can also check out our list of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2621270/discussions/0/4036977429243711876/]known issues[/url].
